title: Sleeps 10 • Game Room • 8 Min Drive to Broadway!
description:
Our spacious 2736sqft 4-bedroom home is just 8 minutes from Broadway, giving you quick access to downtown while having a comfortable place to relax and hang out!

The highlight of the home is the private game room with a pool table, ping pong, Pac-man machine, cards  and darts + cornhole in the backyard for even more group fun!

The space
📍 Location

Close enough to downtown to get there quickly, but far enough to avoid the noise. You’ll be minutes from Broadway, restaurants, bars, and major venues! A great deal of East Nashville bars are also within walking distance!

🛋️ The Space

The home offers over 2,736 sq ft with a layout that works great for groups:

* 4 bedrooms plus Zen room
* 3 full bathrooms
* Open living area
* Fully equipped kitchen
* Dedicated game room

There’s plenty of space to get ready, unwind, and spend time together without feeling crowded. 

**We want you to have fun, however we DO NOT allow confetti or glitter. If you do use confetti or glitter there will be an additional $200 fee added to your cleaning fee.**

Please note that we do have quite hours as we have neighbors.

Guest access
You will receive the entry code 24 hours before your check-in time.

Other things to note
Additionally, If you have 11-20 guests, We may be able to accommodate your group if the dates are available. Reach out to Alfonso and we can work it out for you :)
